title: Unpinning a technician puts them back where they were
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 5 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • Technicians (examples, the expected results call them by first name or full name): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie", "ZZAUTOTEST Dan Delta". A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • No technician is pinned and your technician order is the starting one: Ana, Ben, Cal, Dan.

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie", "ZZAUTOTEST Dan Delta" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close.
  2. Work Orders > All > Board View: unpin every pinned technician (pin icon in the column header); write down who was pinned so you can pin them back after the case.
  3. Check the setup worked: Board View shows no pinned column and the four technicians read Ana, Ben, Cal, Dan after Unassigned. If you have reordered them earlier, drag them back into that order first.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Click Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View").
  3. Pin Cal (the pin icon in his header). Read the column order.
  4. Unpin Cal (the same pin icon). Read the column order.
  5. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (tooltip "Tech View").
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: Cal moves to the pinned area: Unassigned, Cal, Ana, Ben, Dan.
  • Step 4: Cal returns to his previous place: Unassigned, Ana, Ben, Cal, Dan.
  • Step 5: Tech View shows the same order.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; Work Orders Board View & Tech View Display Options Technical Implementation Plan (revised 24 Sep 2026, uploaded 8 Oct 2026), section 1.4 (SQ-11), confirmed by Sasha Grosman in the PRD footer comment of 24 Sep 2026. Epic SV-10043; story SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S3-R19, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions SQ-11 (29 Sep 2026) still lists the unpin position as open (PO question raised).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R19: “Unpinning frees a slot in both Tech View and Board View.”
  • Tech plan 1.4 SQ-11: “Confirmed: unpin returns to the previous slot; pins/order per user, filtered to technicians of the current location”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
